section_summary: This section covers 1946-47 reporting on narcotics control in occupied Japan. It includes State Department transmittals of Japan's statistical forms to the Permanent Central Opium Board, and GHQ SCAP Narcotic Seizure Reports Nos. 1-6, in original and in UN reprint. It also has UN questionnaire correspondence on opium poppy limitation, a Far Eastern Commission conversation, and blank statistical forms with a Bureau of Narcotics cover letter.

subfiles.about: Concluding notes and table of equivalences from the Board's quarterly import/export statistical form.
subfiles.summary: Notes on cocaine, government imports, frontier statistics and equivalence table for narcotic drugs.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form A(GL) notes (end)

subfiles.about: Transmits Japan's third-quarter 1946 narcotics import/export statistics.
subfiles.summary: Secretary of State sends Form A(GL) for Japan, Q3 1946.
subfiles.title: Transmittal of Form A(GL), third quarter 1946
subfiles.to: President, Permanent Central Opium Board, Bern

subfiles.about: Acknowledges receipt of US notes and annexes.
subfiles.summary: Board secretary acknowledges notes of November and December 1946 with annexes.
subfiles.title: Opium Board acknowledgment

subfiles.about: Encloses seizure reports 1-6 for transmission to the UN Secretary-General under Article 23.
subfiles.summary: Asks request that reports be forwarded to other convention parties.
subfiles.title: Instruction to transmit seizure reports to UN
subfiles.to: US Representative, UN Economic and Social Council

subfiles.about: Cover note with postscript on five sets of Korean seizure reports.
subfiles.summary: Notes Korean seizure reports 1-3 enclosed.
subfiles.title: Bureau of Narcotics covering note

subfiles.about: Japan's quarterly import/export statistics reporting nil.
subfiles.from: Japanese Ministry of Health and Social Affairs (M. Katsumata)
subfiles.summary: Form with instructions and notes; imports and exports of all listed drugs reported as nil for third quarter 1946.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form A(GL), Japan Q3 1946

subfiles.about: Lists medicinal narcotics seized from former Japanese military depots, October 1945-July 1946.
subfiles.summary: Quantities of morphine, cocaine, codeine, opium and pantopon preparations. From 22 July to 20 August 1946 all were delivered to approved wholesale drug houses for civilian distribution.
subfiles.title: SCAP Narcotic Seizure Report No. 1

subfiles.about: Crude and semi-processed opium, morphine and coca seized November 1945-April 1946.
subfiles.summary: Low-morphine opium destroyed; remainder stored under US custody in Yokohama and Kobe.
subfiles.title: SCAP Narcotic Seizure Report No. 2

subfiles.about: Heroin seized and destroyed, total 705.290 kg.
subfiles.summary: Includes adulterated heroin from Tientsin and Peking; heroin now prohibited in Japan.
subfiles.title: SCAP Narcotic Seizure Report No. 3

subfiles.about: Seizure of opium smuggled from Manchuria aboard the Hoei Maru.
subfiles.summary: Eight men moved 177 sacks of raw opium from Manchuria via Korea to Japan; Hoei Maru seized; seventeen defendants tried in Wakayama.
subfiles.title: SCAP Narcotic Seizure Report No. 4

subfiles.about: Seizure of 162 bags of crude opium on the Dai Iti-Koun Maru at Ogata Port.
subfiles.summary: Lists seventeen implicated persons and the smuggling route from Hsinking; opium delivered to US forces.
subfiles.title: SCAP Narcotic Seizure Report No. 5

subfiles.about: Seizure at Ujina of 14 bales of unrefined opium from Singapore.
subfiles.summary: Opium brought by Katsuragi Maru, delivered to Otake Hospital by Ryuzo Kondo, then seized.
subfiles.title: SCAP Narcotic Seizure Report No. 6

subfiles.about: Sends 1946 quarterly statistics and annual stock statistics.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Form A(GL) for four quarters of 1946 and Form D(GL) for stocks at 31 December 1944.
subfiles.title: Transmittal of Forms A(GL) and D(GL), 1946
subfiles.to: President, Permanent Central Opium Board, Bern

subfiles.about: Cover sheet for statistical forms.
subfiles.summary: Treasury narcotics bureau routing cover.
subfiles.title: Bureau of Narcotics covering note

subfiles.about: Annual statistics of narcotic stocks in Japan at 31 December 1944.
subfiles.from: Japanese Ministry of Health and Social Affairs (M. Katsumata)
subfiles.summary: Stocks of opium, morphine and other drugs, with remarks that only one column is accurate and others are estimates; monthly wholesaler reports began July 1946.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form D(GL), Japan stocks 1944

subfiles.about: Finn discusses future narcotics control in Japan after the occupation and the Far Eastern Commission's role.
subfiles.summary: Finn says the FEC lacks jurisdiction after the peace treaty; the UN would have to make arrangements with Japan.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of conversation with Richard Finn

subfiles.about: Sends Japan's fourth-quarter 1946 narcotics statistics.
subfiles.summary: Form A(GL) for Q4 1946 transmitted.
subfiles.title: Transmittal of Form A(GL), fourth quarter 1946

subfiles.about: Forwards UN documents on illicit traffic in opium and dangerous drugs.
subfiles.summary: Copies of UN documents E/NS.1947/66-71 enclosed.
subfiles.title: Transmittal to Treasury of UN documents
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Treasury (Customs Agency Service)

subfiles.about: UN copy of narcotic seizure report No. 1.
subfiles.summary: Quantities of medicinal narcotics seized from former military depots, later released to civilian channels.
subfiles.title: UN document E/NS.1947/66: Seizure Report No. 1

subfiles.about: Communicates SCAP seizure report No. 2 under Article 23.
subfiles.summary: Seizures November 1945-April 1946 with weights in pounds and kilograms.
subfiles.title: UN Note: Seizure Report No. 2

subfiles.about: Cover note for seizure report No. 3.
subfiles.summary: Communicates report on seizures to August 1946.
subfiles.title: UN Note: Seizure Report No. 3 (cover)

subfiles.about: UN copy of heroin seizure report.
subfiles.summary: Heroin totalling 705.290 kg confiscated and destroyed.
subfiles.title: UN E/NS.1947/68: Seizure Report No. 3

subfiles.about: Cover note for seizure report No. 4 on opium seized 8 February 1946.
subfiles.summary: Communicates report No. 4.
subfiles.title: UN Note: Seizure Report No. 4 (cover)

subfiles.about: Remarks section describing the opium smuggling route.
subfiles.summary: 177 sacks moved from Manchuria to Osaki; seventeen defendants; ten bags stolen.
subfiles.title: UN Seizure Report No. 4 (continuation)

subfiles.about: UN communication of report on seizure of 7,480 kg crude opium on 27 February 1946.
subfiles.summary: Lists seventeen implicated persons, Dai Iti-Koun Maru details and smuggling account (E/NS.1947/70).
subfiles.title: UN Note and Seizure Report No. 5

subfiles.about: Asks ILH to draft a reply to the UN Secretariat on forwarding narcotics communications.
subfiles.summary: Requests third-person instruction; subject concerns notifying SCAP political adviser of procedure change.
subfiles.title: Memo: reply to UN on seizure reports procedure

subfiles.about: Encloses UN notes on forwarding narcotics communications and annual reports.
subfiles.summary: Notes dated April 8, 1947 sent for appropriate action.
subfiles.title: Instruction to Political Adviser re UN procedure
subfiles.to: US Political Adviser to SCAP, Tokyo

subfiles.about: Routing slip for UN correspondence.
subfiles.from: Leroy D. Stinebower, US Delegation to UN
subfiles.summary: Delegation transmittal slip.
subfiles.title: US Delegation cover slip

subfiles.about: Sends questionnaire on limiting opium poppy cultivation, requesting reply by 15 August 1947.
subfiles.summary: Asks that Japan, a prewar producer, receive the questionnaire.
subfiles.title: UN circular note on opium poppy questionnaire

subfiles.about: Circular transmitting ECOSOC resolution of 28 March 1947 approving a questionnaire on raw opium.
subfiles.summary: Governments that cultivated poppy 1937-1946 must reply by 15 August 1947; others to say not applicable. Excludes Spain.
subfiles.title: UN circular note on questionnaire

subfiles.about: Acknowledges the 8 April note and says it was forwarded to the State Department.
subfiles.summary: Brief acknowledgment of the UN note.
subfiles.title: US reply acknowledging UN note

subfiles.about: Asks ILH to prepare instruction forwarding the questionnaire to SCAP's Political Adviser.
subfiles.summary: Report requested by 15 August 1947; USDEL letter 2248.
subfiles.title: Memo: questionnaire reply request

subfiles.about: Encloses UN note and questionnaire E/CN.7/63 for Japan to answer by 15 August 1947.
subfiles.summary: Asks whether Japanese authorities can furnish the information.
subfiles.title: Instruction forwarding questionnaire to Political Adviser
subfiles.to: US Political Adviser to SCAP, Tokyo

subfiles.summary: Blank form with instructions and equivalence table.
subfiles.title: Blank Statistical Form A(L)

subfiles.about: Annual consumption statistics form.
subfiles.summary: Blank form with notes and table of equivalences.
subfiles.title: Blank Statistical Form C(1)(GL)

subfiles.about: Annual production and manufacture statistics form.
subfiles.summary: Blank form covering morphine, heroin, cocaine and other drugs, with remarks on Article 6.
subfiles.title: Blank Statistical Form C(2)(GL)

subfiles.about: Annual confiscation statistics with notes and equivalences.
subfiles.summary: Reports 7285 held by US Forces; 634 kg heroin destroyed; 1 kg each morphine, cocaine and codeine seized internally.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form B(L) confiscations, Japan 1946

subfiles.about: Forwards Japanese and Korean 1946 annual statistical forms for transmission to the Board.
subfiles.from: H. J. Anslinger, Commissioner of Narcotics
subfiles.summary: Lists Forms A(L), C(1)(GL), C(2)(GL) and B(L) for 1946, received via Civil Affairs Division.
subfiles.title: Bureau of Narcotics forwarding letter
